data.name: Core Remnants
data.detailed_description:
Command. Survive. Evolve.

You are the last Biocore Pilot — a survivor stranded on a dying alien world.
Your only hope lies within the Biocore system, an ancient technology capable of creating life, weapons, and power beyond human understanding.
But every pulse of energy draws swarms of hostile creatures closer.
Survive long enough to rebuild, upgrade, and uncover what remains of humanity’s final outpost.

Lead Your Squad

You don’t fight alone — command a squad of AI-controlled soldiers, each with unique stats and weapons.

Soldiers automatically shoot enemies, protect you, and level up alongside you.

Merge duplicate soldier cards to strengthen your team — each merge grants a permanent +5% damage bonus to all allies.

Equip alien weapons, experiment with mutators, and customize your formation for any threat.

Customize Alien Weapons

Discover alien tech with unpredictable behavior:

  • Homing missiles, bouncing projectiles, or exploding shots

  • Every run reshapes how your arsenal behaves

  • Combine weapons with soldier perks to create unstoppable synergies

Unlock Perks Through Achievements

Your greatest breakthroughs come from survival itself.

Complete achievements during your runs to unlock powerful Perks — rare, permanent augmentations that change how you and your squad fight.

  • Each achievement unlocks a specific Perk

  • Perks can be equipped to soldiers to grant stat boosts and unique effects

  • Build specialized roles: glass-cannon snipers, poison spreaders, explosive bruisers, or support units

  • Perks are permanent unlocks, but loadouts are yours to customize every run

Progress is tracked across sessions — every milestone brings you closer to your next evolution.

Evolve Through Upgrades

Collect Biocores to upgrade everything — permanently.

Choose between randomized upgrades every level.

Unlock permanent enhancements between sessions.

Increase projectile counts, lifesteal, speed, raw damage… and now, Perk power.

Every run feels different, every upgrade matters.

Race Against Time

Each session has a strict time limit.
Defeat enemies to extend your life — or watch the clock run out.
Every boss kill adds 60 seconds, but with each passing wave, enemies grow stronger.

Survive Endless Waves

Face escalating hordes across alien biomes:

  • Enemies scale every wave

  • Defeat bosses with massive HP bars

  • How long can you survive before the planet consumes you?

Set Your Challenge

Adjust the difficulty slider to define your experience:

  • Higher difficulty = stronger enemies, higher Biocore multipliers, and bigger rewards

  • Each difficulty tracks its own highest wave record
    Prove your dominance at every level.

Core Features

  • Procedural wave escalation system

  • Dozens of weapon mutators and stat effects

  • Fully automated companion AI and soldier formation

  • Merging system for team-wide permanent buffs

  • Achievement-driven Perk unlock system with soldier loadouts

  • Explosive boss fights with arena-wide attacks

  • Difficulty slider, upgrade trees, and XP leveling

  • Persistent save system across sessions

data.short_description: Core Remnants is a fast-paced top-down roguelite where you command a squad of biomechanical soldiers. Battle through swarming alien hordes, mutate your gear and companions after every wave, and permanently upgrade between runs. Build the ultimate squad!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 950 / AMD Radeon RX 460 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7600 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 590 (4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
